title: Vibrant Crisp Jamaican Chicken Skewers
description: A tangy and crisp Jamaican dish featuring green salsa, perfect for a low-calorie dinner, cooked to perfection on an iron teppan.
instructions: Preheat the iron teppan to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lime juice, jerk seasoning, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the iron teppan with a small amount of oil to prevent sticking.
Cook the chicken skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until they reach an internal temperature of 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the chicken is cooking, heat the green salsa in a small saucepan over low heat.
Once the chicken is cooked, brush it with the heated green salsa.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve immediately.
